rationale: C18 plausibly supplied a concrete template for the child: announce a successful scientific-technical undertaking, characterize its broader significance, and ask the addressee to convey presidential congratulations or commendation to the personnel across multiple participating organizations. The close sequence and repeated formulations such as “successful,” “contributed,” and “Please convey ... to all” are materially more distinctive than generic congratulatory-letter conventions. C10 supplies the notable scientific phrase about extending “man's knowledge of the universe,” but lacks the child's operative congratulatory structure; C03 has a weaker convey-appreciation pattern.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The successful launching early today of the space probe, Pioneer IV, marks yet another major step in scientific space exploration.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The successful completion of this mission is an outstanding example of cooperation between the Agencies responsible for the military defense of the nation and those responsible for the scientific and technical development
shared_material.explanation: Both open from the successful completion of a major scientific-technical mission and immediately state its broader significance.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Please convey my warm congratulations for this splendid achievement to all who contributed to it in your own agency, in the Army, and among your scientific associates.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Please convey to the Commander of Join Task Force Seven and to all of the member of the National Military Establishment who contributed to the success of the undertaking my commendation for a job well done.
shared_material.explanation: This is a close parallel in wording and function: “Please convey” presidential praise to “all” personnel who “contributed” to the success, with the recipient serving as intermediary.

shared_material.child_excerpt: to all who contributed to it in your own agency, in the Army, and among your scientific associates

shared_material.explanation: Both emphasize coordinated contributions from military, governmental, and scientific participants.
